summary.text: Erika White is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 41 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A broadband engineer at AT&T, she serves on the Commerce and Labor, Financial Institutions, Public Insurance and Pensions, and Technology and Innovation committees.

paragraphs.text: Erika White's career experience includes working as a broadband engineer at AT&T, according to Ballotpedia.

Ballotpedia lists her affiliations as CWA 4319, the CWA National Executive Board-Diversity Board, the Greater Northwest Ohio AFL-CIO, the Healthy Lucas County Health Improvement Plan, the Lucas County Mental Health & Recovery Services Executive Board and the Toledo NAACP.
White assumed office in the Ohio House of Representatives on January 1, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
Ian Chamberlin (R) is the other candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
